        "snippet": "If that does not work, follow these simple troubleshooting steps depending on whether the issue is with your router, phone, or computer."

        "snippet": "Quick Checks for Your Router"
      },

        "type": "list",
        "list": [

            "snippet": "Check cables: Ensure the cables connecting your modem to your router are secure."

            "snippet": "Test other devices: Connect another phone or laptop to the same Wi-Fi."
          },
          {
            "snippet": "Identify the source: If no device has internet, your internet service provider (ISP) may have an outage, or your router needs a deeper reset."

        "type": "paragraph",
        "snippet": "Learn how to fix Wi-Fi connected without internet by restarting your equipment:"

        "snippet": "Fixes for Phones and Mobile Devices"
      },
      {
        "type": "list",
        "list": [
          {
            "snippet": "Toggle Airplane Mode: Turn on Airplane Mode for 30 seconds, then turn it off to refresh all wireless radios."
          },
          {
            "snippet": "Check Date and Time: Go to your device settings and ensure your date and time are set to update automatically via the network."
          },
          {
            "snippet": "Forget the Network: Go to your Wi-Fi settings, select Forget on your network, then reconnect by re-entering your password."
          },
          {
            "snippet": "Disable VPN: Turn off any active virtual private network (VPN) or custom private DNS settings."
          }
